author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Brendan Fraser was one of Hollywood's biggest stars, so how did he suddenly disappear?

From The Mummy and George of the Jungle to Bedazzled, Blast From the Past, and Gods and Monsters, Fraser seemed almost impossible to stop. He could do comedy, action, drama, and practically everything in between. But behind the blockbuster success was a career taking an increasingly brutal toll.

And after nearly a decade away from mainstream Hollywood, Brendan Fraser's incredible comeback proved that his story was far from over.

So what actually happened to Brendan Fraser?

title: How Hollywood Almost Broke Brendan Fraser
